**Organizational Background**

LoopStream Technologies (OPC) Private Limited is a dynamic and fast-growing organization committed

to delivering innovative solutions across data services, IT operations, and business process outsourcing.

Founded with the belief that passion, empowerment, and wellbeing drive true success, LoopStream

Technologies has built a reputation as a trusted partner for clients across industries from healthcare to

insurance and technology.

With a focus on operational excellence, we align our services and solutions with client goals, ensuring

not just efficient delivery but also meaningful impact. Our culture is anchored in resilience, adaptability,

and continuous improvement, enabling our teams to transform challenges into growth opportunities.

**Our Values:**

At LoopStream Technologies, our work is guided by three core values that define who we are and

how we operate.

Passion We bring energy, commitment, and creativity to every project, constantly pushing

boundaries to deliver excellence.

Empowerment We believe in uplifting our teams, fostering a culture where every individual has

the tools, voice, and support to reach their full potential.

Wellbeing We prioritize the holistic wellbeing of our people, recognizing that true success is

built on balance, resilience, and a positive workplace environment.

Together, these values drive us to build strong partnerships, create innovative solutions, and nurture

a company culture where both people and business can thrive.

For further details visit www.loopstreamtech.com

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a proactive and service-oriented Workplace Coordinator to ensure the smooth

functioning of daily office operations. The role involves managing front office activities, maintaining

office cleanliness and pantry services, handling visitor and attendance records, supporting walk-in

candidates, coordinating with various departments, and assisting in employee engagement initiatives.

The ideal candidate will work closely with the People & Culture Coordinator to create a positive and

welcoming workplace experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Front Office & Visitor Management**

* Welcome and assist visitors, guests, and walk-in candidates professionally.
* Maintain visitor and candidate registers, including entry and exit records.
* Coordinate candidate arrivals with hiring managers and the People & Culture team.
* Guide walk-in candidates through registration and interview processes.
* Ensure interview rooms are prepared and ready prior to scheduled interviews.
* Create a positive first impression for visitors, candidates, and employees.

**Attendance & Record Management**

* Maintain and update employee attendance records accurately.
* Monitor daily attendance and report discrepancies when required.
* Maintain records of late arrivals, absences, and leave information.
* Ensure all attendance and visitor records are properly maintained and updated.

**Office Administration**

* Ensure the office premises are clean, organized, and presentable at all the times.
* Monitor cleanliness of reception, meeting rooms, pantry, and common areas.
* Coordinate with housekeeping staff to maintain office hygiene and cleanliness standards.
* Support day-to-day office administration activities.

**Pantry Management**

* Manage pantry operations and maintain pantry cleanliness.
* Arrange and serve tea, coffee, and refreshments two times daily.
* Ensure adequate stock of beverages, drinking water, and pantry consumables.
* Coordinate refreshments for meetings, visitors, interviews, and company events.

**Inventory & Supplies Management**

* Monitor and maintain stock levels of pantry and office consumables.
* Coordinate replenishment of stationery, tissues, drinking water, pantry supplies, and cleaning

materials.

* Receive, organize, and store office supplies appropriately.
* Inform management of procurement requirements and low stock levels.

**Department Coordination**

* Coordinate with all departments for administrative and operational requirements.
* Follow up on office-related requests and ensure timely support.
* Assist in organizing meetings, training sessions, and internal activities.

**Employee Engagement & People & Culture Support**

* Act as a support resource for office coordination and operational requirements.
* Support employee engagement activities, celebrations, and cultural events.
* Assist in organizing birthdays, festivals, team events, wellness activities, and employee

recognition programs.

* Coordinate event logistics, refreshments, decorations, and required arrangements.
* Work closely with and align administrative activities with the People & Culture Coordinator.
* Support onboarding activities and employee experience initiatives as required.

**Required Education Qualification**

* Diploma, or Bachelor’s degree in any discipline.
* Freshers with good communication and coordination skills are encouraged to apply.

**Required Skills**

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational and coordination abilities.
* Service-oriented and professional attitude.
* Ability to multitask and manage routine administrative activities.
* Attention to detail and workplace cleanliness.
* Basic record-keeping and inventory management skills.
* Teamwork and collaboration mindset.
* Reliability, punctuality, and accountability.

**Grow into roles such as:**

* **Senior Front Office Executive**
* **Office Administrator**

**How You Can Grow in This Role**

As a Front Office Admin, you will gain exposure to administration, employee engagement, recruitment

coordination, office operations, and People & Culture activities. With consistent performance, you can

* Administration Coordinator
* People & Culture Coordinator
* HR & Administration Executive
* Employee Experience Coordinator

This role provides an excellent opportunity to develop organizational, coordination, and employee

engagement skills while building a strong foundation in administration and workplace operations.

Pay: From ₹12,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Non IT Recruiter
description:
**About the Role**

HealthSy and HealthSy Pharmacy are scaling their retail pharmacy network and corporate teams. We need an owner-minded recruiter who can run the full hiring cycle independently, from understanding the requirement to the candidate’s first day. You will hire mainly for pharmacy retail roles and non-IT corporate functions. Success here comes from finding talent through channels beyond the usual job portals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Requirement and JD creation**

* Meet hiring managers to understand role needs, urgency, budget, and success criteria
* Write clear, role-specific JDs and job posts for each position
* Define the hiring plan, timelines, and TAT for each requisition

**2. Sourcing (beyond Naukri and Indeed)**

* Research and build sourcing channels for each role type, for example:
* Pharmacy colleges, D.Pharm/B.Pharm alumni groups, and pharmacy council and association networks
* LinkedIn, Telegram and WhatsApp communities, Facebook groups, and local job groups
* Walk-in drives, campus drives, and local job fairs
* Employee referrals, agencies, and competitor mapping (pharmacy chains, hospital pharmacies, retail)
* Apna, WorkIndia, Shine, Foundit, Quikr Jobs, and regional job boards
* Track which channels convert and double down on what works
* Maintain a talent pool and pipeline for recurring roles

**3. Screening and coordination**

* Screen candidates on skills, licensing (e.g., valid pharmacist registration), experience, stability, and culture fit
* Schedule and coordinate interviews with hiring managers and store/area teams
* Keep candidates engaged and informed throughout the process

**4. Offer, closure and onboarding**

* Negotiate and close offers within budget
* Handle documentation, background and reference checks, and offer rollout
* Follow up until joining and reduce drop-offs between offer and joining
* Coordinate with HR and operations for a smooth Day 1 and early check-ins

**5. Reporting and process**

* Maintain trackers and ATS or Excel dashboards (open positions, pipeline, TAT, source-wise performance, offer-to-join ratio)
* Share weekly hiring updates with leadership
* Suggest process improvements and cost-effective hiring practices

**Roles You Will Hire For**

* **Store-level:** Pharmacist, Store Incharge, Store Manager
* **Corporate/office (non-IT):** Supply Chain Management (SCM), Operations, and related support functions
* Other business roles as they arise

**Requirements**

* 1-3 years of recruitment experience, preferably in **volume hiring, healthcare, or retail experience** is a strong plus.
* Hands-on experience with passive hiring on LinkedIn (LinkedIn Recruiter or free search and outreach
* Proven **end-to-end recruitment experience** (sourcing to onboarding)
* Hands-on experience with non-portal sourcing: social media, community groups, referrals, drives.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills
* Ability to handle multiple open positions and tight timelines
* Comfortable with trackers, Excel/Google Sheets, and an ATS
* Willingness to coordinate with stores across locations; knowledge of regional languages is a plus
* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR is preferred but not mandatory
* Based in Coimbatore, or willing to relocate to Coimbatore

**Skills and Attributes**

* Ownership mindset: you stay with the candidate until they join
* Resourceful and research-driven, with creativity in finding talent
* Target- and TAT-oriented, with a strong follow-up discipline
* Professional, empathetic, and honest candidate communication
* Self-starter who can work with minimal supervision

**What Success Looks Like**

* Positions closed within agreed TAT
* High offer-to-joining conversion
* A growing set of effective, low-cost sourcing channels
* Strong pharmacist and store-manager pipelines ready for new store launches
* Positive hiring-manager and candidate experience

**What We Offer**

* Ownership of the complete hiring function in a fast-growing healthcare retail brand
* Competitive compensation: [CTC range]

**To apply:** Send your resume to **careers@healthsy.in** with the subject line “**Recruiter - HealthSy”**.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* How many years of end-to-end recruitment experience do you have?
* How many positions did you handle at a time, and what was your monthly closure count?
* Current CTC per Month
* Notice Period?
* Are you currently based in Coimbatore, or willing to relocate?

Work Location: In person

title: HR Recruiter
description:
Job Description – Recruiter

**Company:** KG Invicta Services (KGiS)  
**Designation:** Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Executive  
**Department:** Human Resources – Talent Acquisition  
**Location:** Coimbatore  
**Experience:** 1–3 years

Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Recruiter to manage end-to-end recruitment activities, identify suitable candidates, and support business hiring requirements. The ideal candidate should have strong communication, sourcing, screening, and coordination skills.

Key Responsibilities

* Understand hiring requirements and job descriptions from hiring managers.
* Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, referrals, job portals, and internal databases.
* Screen resumes and assess candidates based on role requirements, experience, communication, and salary expectations.
* Conduct initial telephonic screenings and evaluate candidate suitability.
* Explain job responsibilities, salary, shifts, work location, and company benefits to candidates.
* Schedule interviews and coordinate with candidates, interview panels, and hiring managers.
* Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process to minimize dropouts and no-shows.
* Maintain accurate candidate records, interview feedback, and recruitment status in the ATS or recruitment tracker.
* Manage walk-in drives, bulk hiring, campus recruitment, and other recruitment initiatives as required.
* Track recruitment metrics, including sourcing, screening, interview scheduling, selection, offer acceptance, and joining.
* Coordinate offer rollouts, documentation, and pre-joining follow-ups.
* Ensure recruitment activities are completed within the agreed timelines and hiring targets.
* Maintain a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.

Required Skills

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Good sourcing and candidate-screening skills.
* Ability to understand job descriptions and assess candidate fitment.
* Knowledge of job portals and recruitment tools.
* Strong follow-up, coordination, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple requirements and meet hiring targets.
* Good time management, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, email, and recruitment tracking systems.

Preferred Qualifications

title: On-site Technology Senior Support Specialist
description:
Location: Coimbatore
Other locations: Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive
Date: 17 Sept 2026
**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1742013
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**On\-site Technology Senior Support Specialist**


**(Senior Associate)**

  


**Enterprise Technology (ET)**



Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to support over 300,000 EY people. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and world\-class technology infrastructure.



Our aim is to build an outstanding customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business specialists to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.

  


**The opportunity**



As part of Enterprise Technology, the On\-site Technology Support’s mission is to help our customers fulfil their purposes and contribute to building a better working world by providing a fit for purpose support service.



The On\-site Technology Support Senior Specialist provides this support to customers within the country or site by performing the highest level of multiple technology support activities. This professional provides meaningful contributions to team efforts to enhance effectiveness; acts creatively to prioritize tasks; interprets information; and applies technical knowledge to satisfy customer and firm objectives. This professional anticipates technology support issues and creates solutions with appropriate consultation.

  


**Your key responsibilities**


* Facilitate and support the deployment of hardware and software to end users (including the installation, configuration and testing of more complex firm hardware).
* Assist with (or coordinate) the repair of end user hardware and the reinstallation of software as necessary to resolve end user incidents.
* Resolve complex incidents associated with firm\-standard end user software and hardware, including mobile/hand\-held technologies. Identify sources and trends of technical problems to prevent future occurrences.
* Acts as a lead to less experienced specialists
* Provide after\-hours service for escalated issues or tasks from the Service Desk or supervisor.
* Perform asset management activities (procurement, receipt, inventory, tracking, distribution, etc.) as assigned and in accordance with firm policy and EY Technology process.
* Anticipates technology support issues and acts to creatively to prioritize tasks, interpret solutions and apply knowledge to facilitate the development and implementation of technical business solutions to complex customer technology needs and issues
* Works independently on small projects and assesses the local needs of area offices and responds appropriately
* Document and track the status of enquiries, coordinate appropriate responses and follow\-up to ensure customer satisfaction
* Work effectively as “remote hands” for other EY Technology functions, such as Telecommunications and Hosting.
* Maintain a thorough understanding of EY Technology’s organization and service offerings in order to identify how best to address end user technology needs and incidents.
* Understand the Firm’s business and organization sufficiently to anticipate and resolve end user technology issues that affect productivity of Firm personnel
* This role is required to physically work in an EY office.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Advanced analytical skills are required to address end\-user incidents escalated from the service desk or offered by end user on walk\-up issues.
* Decision making responsibilities can be made to address issues impacting large numbers of customers within the supported geography and communicate effectively to customers as necessary.
* Experience in leading projects and overseeing contribution and performance of project members
* A Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience is desirable.

  


**To qualify for the role you must have**


* Exceptional communication, interpersonal, organizational, project and time management skills.
* Excellent customer service attitude.
* Demonstrated multitasking abilities in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to liaise and work effectively with all levels of end users and IT personnel.
* Ability to communicate effectively with supervisor and peers.
* Approximately 4\-8 years of extensive experience in end user software and hardware and technology support

  


**What we offer**



As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:


* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
